name: arch-kele-structure-photo
title_zh: 每张照片出两张图：一张结构研究稿，一张带原图角标
tagline_zh: 一张照片出两张：一张干净的结构研究水彩，一张右上角嵌着原片对照。暖纸底、分析线、克制的标注，配色从照片里取。
tagline_en: Two outputs per photo: a clean structural-study artwork, and one with the untouched source inset top-right. Warm paper, construction lines, restrained labels, palette derived from the photo.
desc_en: Two outputs per photo: a clean structural-study artwork, and one with the untouched source inset top-right. Warm paper, construction lines, restrained labels, palette derived from the photo.
why_zh: 它要求几何仍可辨认——建筑、物件、人、动植物、街景都按同一套方法拆，不是套一层水彩滤镜。
why_en: Geometry must stay recognizable — architecture, objects, people, plants, streetscapes all follow one method; it is not a watercolor filter.
limit_zh: 附带的示例只准用来校准风格，不准影响主体和配色——作者写死了这条。人像和动物也走同一方法，但识别度靠几何保留，不靠五官。只出图，不出可编辑源文件。
limit_en: Bundled examples are for style calibration only, never subject or palette. Image output only.
title_en: Two prints per photo: study sheet + source-inset plate
